description: One kind of stone, a seven by seven board, and a race to turn the board your colour.

sections.markdown:
There is only one piece, the stone. On your turn pick one of your stones and either:

- **clone** it onto an adjacent empty square (the original stays), or
- **jump** it two squares away (the original leaves).

Either way, every enemy stone next to the square you land on **changes to your colour**.

A player who cannot move loses, so crowd your opponent out.
